gse244832.allowed_use: External-development unpaired integration and donor-by-cell-state RNA-to-ATAC profile comparison after fitting on outer-training bridge data.
gse244832.model_access: RNA and ATAC aliquots use distinct barcodes. Neither held modality enters training, feature intersection, XGBoost correction, model selection, or calibration.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time RNA-only cell-state mapping after selection lock. It cannot confirm RNA-to-ATAC because no observed ATAC endpoint exists.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA only through a frozen eval-mode encoder; dataset-specific adjustments disabled and no query rows appended to training.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-training same-nucleus multimodal bridge plus donor-held development cell-state and RNA-conditioned ATAC evaluation after activation gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Feature inventories, model, batch policy, optional training-only latent correction, head, and calibration use outer-training donors only; held ATAC is evaluator-only.

local_model_roster.common_lane: raw deterministic posterior-mean embedding plus identical common head
local_model_roster.native_lane: training-only latent correction and native clustering reported separately; no held-query correction fit

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot with distinct barcodes and structural modality absence
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus exact shared barcode only after join validation

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, topics, and peaks are not replicates.
rules.profile_scale: ATAC decoder output is a depth-free multinomial feature composition on frozen peaks.
rules.query_isolation: Force eval/no-grad, use posterior mean, disable dataset adjustments, and never fit latent correction on held rows.
rules.transform_contract: Training-only gene/peak intersections and order, model state, head, and calibration.
